sources.title: Display formatted native titles in another and ChatGPT
sources.quote: and both in another and displayed session title in chatgpt client
sources.note: Confirmed in the implementation conversation. The user requested both local Codex threads and cloud ChatGPT chats; an app-hosted capability probe was approved first. No source message ID was exposed by the harness. The full automation remains pending.

sources.title: Codex app server
sources.note: Wire shapes were verified against schemas generated by the installed Codex 0.165.0-alpha.1.2 app-server: initialize, initialized, thread/name/set, and metadata-only thread/read. The documentation's original publication date was not established.

sources.title: Codex native name versus legacy title verification
sources.note: ChatGPT Desktop 26.1023.51421 build 22530 showed the original name while another showed a formatted legacy title. Read-only inspection found different threads.name and threads.title values; native thread/read matched name. Native thread/name/set followed by thread/read verified the corrected name. The maintainer subsequently confirmed it worked; whether the client needed a list reload was not recorded. The separate app-hosted probe was rejected by code-signing checks; no authentication or signing checks were bypassed.

sources.title: Native title fix accepted after development testing
sources.note: Acceptance followed native title repair, readback verification, and installation of the tested development build. Under the project release contract, acceptance authorizes delivery of this fix. No message ID was exposed by the harness.
